correctness.rationale: The exact transition partition is verified by counting left-right intersection endpoints, giving the finite rational recurrence. The conditional drift identity and factorial-moment supermartingale provide an all-size proof of \(2/(n+1)-4H_{n-1}/(n(n+1))\le q_n\le 2/(n+1)\), and thus \(nq_n\to2\). Independent compressed and labeled-mask rational verifiers replay through \(n=8\), with \(n=9,10\) checked in compressed form; finite checks corroborate rather than replace the proof. Rate equality and both boundary cases are specified.

The evidence supports best-knowledge originality, not historical uniqueness.

value.rationale: The exact jamming failure probability on a physically natural dense bipartite adsorption family distinguishes irreversible kinetic selection from static derangement counts. The probability exhibits a sharp all-size \(2/n\) limit with explicit harmonic error, exact finite-size rational recurrence, and a unique defect geometry. It is motivated as a benchmark for random dimer packing and matching inefficiency, beyond routine finite enumeration.
